summary.text: Eileen Eady is the Democratic candidate for Nevada State Assembly District 4 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Lisa Cole.

paragraphs.text: Eady ran in the 2018 nonpartisan primary for Clark County School District Board of Trustees District F, finishing with 10.0 percent of the vote.
In 2024 she ran for the Board of Trustees District B seat and lost the general election to Lydia Dominguez, 56.2 percent to 43.8 percent.
